name: voiceover-shorts-tts
description: Make a narration WAV and word timings (words.json) from text through the ElevenLabs API, using your own ElevenLabs key, for the voiceover-shorts plugin

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Your own ElevenLabs API key. Stored in secure storage and passed only to the add-on's MCP server.

voice_id.title: Voice ID
voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice ID to narrate with. You are responsible for having the rights to the voice you choose.

output_format.title: Output format
output_format.description: WAV format requested from ElevenLabs. wav_44100 may require a Pro account.

max_chars_per_call.title: Max characters per call
max_chars_per_call.description: Upper limit on text length sent in one paid ElevenLabs request.

api_base.title: ElevenLabs API host
api_base.description: ElevenLabs API host. Pick the one matching your account's data residency.
